first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. Verify those records before running a guarded test. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because it previously reduced 30-day retention, creating downstream qualified-revenue risk.

final.rationale: Run a targeted onboarding simplification test for simple SMB workspaces, where prior evidence shows improved completion, activation, and qualified revenue. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortening onboarding increased their 60-day churn by 9% by removing necessary setup steps. Monitor activation, completion, time-to-value, 30-day retention, 60-day churn, and qualified revenue before expanding.
